name: Beppu Contemporary Art Festival
funding: Run by the BEPPU PROJECT NPO with the city.
watch: Last full festival was in 2015. Oita Gas, a natural-gas utility, is a current sponsor. No protest was found; the exclusion comes from the fossil-fuel rule alone.
why_flagged: Last full festival was in 2015. Oita Gas, a natural-gas utility, is a current sponsor. No protest was found; the exclusion comes from the fossil-fuel rule alone.
records_note: Beppu Project posts festival reports for 2012 to 2014 with income and spending, a named 2025 sponsor list of about 30, and no board.

name: Bergen International Festival
records_note: The festival posts no annual report, but its foundation files annual accounts in Norway's register; it names its sponsors and seven board members.

name: Bienal de La Habana
watch: In October 2021 an open letter with over 400 signatures called for a boycott of the 14th edition; at least five participants withdrew.
why_flagged: State-sponsored show organised since 1984 by the government-supported Wifredo Lam Center of Contemporary Art.
records_note: The Wifredo Lam Center's site, which runs the Havana Biennial, failed to open, so none of the four questions could be checked.

name: Biennale of Sydney
watch: Dropped Transfield 2014; now lists Qatar Museums and Sharjah entities.
why_flagged: Qatar Museums is Major Strategic Partner of the 2026 edition; Fondation Cartier is Visionary Partner. Transfield, a sponsor for 41 years, left in 2014.
records_note: Biennale of Sydney posts a report per edition for 2018 to 2024, files accounts with the ACNC, names main funders undated, and lists ten directors.

name: Biomuseo
watch: The museum's own memberships page (2024) lists its corporate members: AES, CAU Internacional, Compañía Digital de Televisión, Escapes Magazine, Grupo Grada, Guidebooks, JIDSA, Kantar Mercaplan and Mapas de Panamá. AES runs the AES Colón power station, an operating 381MW combined-cycle plant burning LNG since 2018, which Global Energy Monitor tracks in its oil and gas plant tracker. The board is led by Fundación Amador. La Prensa reports that protests cut the museum's cash flow by 70%.

name: Black Family Visual Arts Center (Dartmouth)
watch: Leon and Debra Black gave $48 million toward the arts centre, which opened in 2012. Epstein had been a director of the Black Family Foundation, through which the gifts passed; he is still listed on its 2012 tax forms, which the Blacks call an error, saying he left in 2007.
why_flagged: Leon and Debra Black gave $48 million toward the centre, which opened in 2012, through the Black Family Foundation. Dartmouth says it has no current financial relationship with Leon Black.
records_note: No records of its own: parent Dartmouth posts audited financial statements for 2002 to 2025 and names its 25 trustees; no annual report found.

name: Bluecoat
funding: £2.4M income (FY2025); Arts Council, Liverpool City Council, Culture Liverpool.
watch: Its trust list is from the FY2023 accounts. Business members are not named publicly.
why_flagged: Its trust list is from the FY2023 accounts. Business members are not named publicly.
records_note: No annual reports found; accounts are on the Charity Commission register, the homepage Funded by block is undated logos, and board members are listed.

name: Bocas Lit Fest
location: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
funding: NGC, the state National Gas Company, was title sponsor through 2024. 2026 main sponsors: Ministry of Culture, JB Fernandes Trust, OCM; Massy and ANSA McAL foundations and Methanex also support.
watch: NGC part-funded 2024 and gave nothing in 2025; its name left the festival title that year. The festival was founded in 2011.
why_flagged: NGC, the state National Gas Company, was title sponsor through 2024. 2026 main sponsors: Ministry of Culture, JB Fernandes Trust, OCM; Massy and ANSA McAL foundations and Methanex also support.
records_note: Annual reports run from 2020 to 2025, the 2020 one with a percentage financial summary; sponsors are logos dated 2026; the board is listed.

name: British Museum
watch: Trustee Ahdaf Soueif resigned over BP in 2019; 80 signed a 2023 open letter. The Sackler name left by agreement in 2022.
why_flagged: BP gives £50M over ten years for the masterplan, announced 19 December 2023. The Sackler name came off its rooms and endowments in 2022.
records_note: It posts reports and audited accounts for 2022 to 2025, names donors in its 2022-23 review, and lists 21 trustees on its governance page.

name: Brooklyn Museum
watch: 2024 occupation; trustees' homes vandalised; BNY link disputed.
why_flagged: 2024 occupation; trustees' homes vandalised; BNY link disputed.
records_note: Its site blocked checks; ProPublica holds Form 990s for 2001 to 2025 with audits for 2022 and 2025, and a trustee page exists.

name: Bukhara Biennial
watch: The 2025 partners page lists the Lead Partners as the Tourism Committee of Uzbekistan, the Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and Bukhara Oil. That is a fossil-fuel company in a lead (founding-edition) role. The Partners are Acwa Power, Agrobank, Apex Insurance, Media City, Ocard, Uzcard, Uzum, Vision Invest and Yandex Uzbekistan. The organiser is the Uzbekistan Art and Culture Development Foundation, commissioned by Gayane Umerova.

name: C/O Berlin
watch: The C/O Berlin Friends page lists corporate members at €5,000 a year: DKB AG (bank), GASAG AG and Pfizer Deutschland (pharma). GASAG is the main natural-gas supplier in Berlin. A December 2020 report put its owners at E.ON 37%, Vattenfall 31.5% and Engie 31.5%. That makes it a current fossil-fuel funder partly owned by E.ON, a name under campaign. The about page names the Senate Department for Culture as public funder and LOTTO-Stiftung Berlin as past renovation funder. No protest at C/O itself was found.
